title: 30A Showhouse | Luxurious 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Iconic 30A Showhouse with Gulf views, private pool, rooftop lounge, elevator, and private beach access—luxury living between Rosemary and Alys Beach.
description_expanded: 30A Showhouse Features - High-end Everything! This is the best house on 30A according to Atlanta Homes and Lifestyles Magazine - Gulf views from the rooftop outdoor lounge and perch - 30-second walk to the private neighborhood beach. Only shared with 19 other homes. - Incredible private pool off the 2nd floor main living area. Pool can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - March - The pool deck features cushioned lounge chairs and a bar window opening to the dining room wet bar. The window bar has seating for 4 - Santimo Beach is a gated neighborhood located between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, making it convenient to walk or bike to explore both neighborhoods with upscale dining and shopping options in minutes - Access to 6 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your arrival - Private elevator travels to floors 1 through 4. Adult use only. Please ask for details regarding mobility considerations for anyone in your group. - Sonos Sound System with 6 zones - 2nd Floor main living room with sliding door entrance to the pool deck, Smart TV, and sound bar - 2nd Floor Gourmet Kitchen with professional grade appliances from Wolf and Subzero, including a full-size fridge and separate full-size freezer, two dishwashers, and wet bar - Breakfast bar seating for 5 - 2nd Floor Dining room with seating for 12 at the custom banquet plus wet bar with beverage chiller drawer and views of the pool - 2nd Floor TV room with Smart TV - 4th Floor "Nest" with Smart TV, game table for 4, and wet bar with beverage chiller drawer and dishwasher - 4th floor outdoor lounge with seating set around the fire pit and two-hole putting green. Clubs and golf balls provided. - Incredible deluxe primary suite on the 3rd Floor with private TV room (private office is not available) - Laundry rooms on the 1st and 3rd Floors - Garage parking for 2 vehicles and driveway parking for 2 vehicles - WIFI throughout the home - Concierge services available including beach chair rentals, grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and private chef catering - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Atlanta Homes and Lifestyles' Magazine inaugural 30A Showhouse is a 6,400-square-foot residence celebrating coastal simplicity on Florida's beloved Gulf Coast, located in a charming, gated community situated between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. The design-build team of Benecki Homes, Melanie Turner Interiors, Source, Lew Oliver, Inc., and Chase Green Built combined their talents for the amenity-filled, high-style show home. The Gulfside 30A sanctuary is in the gated Santimo Beach development on Elysee Court, a 20-lot neighborhood nestled between the luxury communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach on scenic 30A with a private beach. Easily walk or bike to upscale shopping and dining or hire a private chef for the ultimate vacation experience. The architecture is a fusion of classicism and modern influenced by Deco and Aegean styles. A clean, restrained aesthetic speaks to the simplicity of today's beach living. The exterior elevates proportion and scale, evident in the windows, iron balconies and white stucco facade. A lookout tower serves as the exclamation point. Area Update - Ongoing Enhancements Along 30A The 30A area continues to flourish, with new homes, boutique developments, and community enhancements taking shape throughout our coastal towns. While this progress adds to the long-term beauty and value of the area, occasional construction activity may be present nearby during your stay. Rest assured, the peaceful coastal atmosphere and exceptional comfort of your home remain our top priority.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
